primary_sources.paper: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
observed: The primary transformation matrix contains 1,296 controlled synthetic episodes across six model variants, five static transformation families, and three dynamic trajectories; each transformed condition is paired against a direct or schema-preserving control on the same source task.

In the primary matrix, direct controls show 100.0% operational preservation, 0.0% deactivation and 0.0% forbidden action; multihop compression is 97.2% deactivation and 31.9% forbidden action, ownership deferral 76.7%/60.8%, commitment assimilation 65.3%/29.2%, and repeated low-risk framing 76.4%/33.3%.

The headline 100.0% deactivation / 54.2% forbidden-action normal-handoff result comes from the separate fixed-task compression-gradient panel with n=48 per condition, not from a single cell of the 1,296-episode primary matrix. In that panel direct/light/normal/compressed/aggressive unsafe rates are 0.0/0.0/54.2/83.3/79.2%.
The fixed-artifact component-restoration panel uses 64 degraded artifacts per intervention: no-repair is P=4.7%, D=95.3%, unsafe=81.2%; restoring all four fields gives P=100.0%, D=0.0%, unsafe=0.0%.

A separate downstream-verification panel holds the degraded artifact fixed across 640 executor episodes. Preservation remains 4.7% and deactivation 95.3% while forbidden action falls from 85.2% under plain artifact-only execution to 1.6% with a soft visible-authorization check and 0.0% under a hard visible-authorization check, external permission lookup, or human approval.

Field-level endpoint necessity is not identified. In the component-restoration panel status-only repair drives unsafe to 0.0% while D remains 73.4%, whereas prerequisite-only repair retains the prerequisite in every artifact but leaves unsafe at 73.4%. In leave-one-field-out fixed-artifact replay, omitting prerequisite, authority, or fallback yields 0.0% unsafe in that executor setting; the paper explicitly labels relative endpoint necessity among those fields inconclusive.

Artifact preservation/deactivation is a prespecified structured-checker outcome. A blind five-model-judge audit tests measurement transport. Worst-case label-flip analysis leaves the deactivation contrast identified through 20% tested flips but makes the pooled forbidden-action contrast inconclusive at 15-20% flips, so evidence for artifact weakening is stronger than evidence for one exact endpoint magnitude.

The paper explicitly places production prevalence, human-team prevalence, and transport to other binding-state classes outside the identified estimand. No first-party code/data repository is linked in the arXiv metadata or paper text observed in this audit, so the published numerical panels were not independently rerun.

material_findings.claim: Lossy handoff transformations can causally weaken binding blocker state and change downstream action in the tested workflow family.
material_findings.scope: The stage-separated matched design holds source state and finite action semantics fixed while changing the representation available to the local-view executor. The main transformation matrix and validation panel support a transformation effect across the measured model configurations. Production prevalence and other binding-state classes are explicitly outside the paper's estimand.

material_findings.claim: Normal handoff compression causes 100.0% deactivation and 54.2% forbidden action across the 1,296 primary episodes.
material_findings.scope: The 100.0% / 54.2% pair is real, but it is from the separate artifact-only compression-gradient panel with n=48 for the normal-handoff condition. The 1,296-episode primary matrix's multihop-compression row is 97.2% deactivation / 31.9% unsafe. The worker did not explicitly say the 54.2% cell was itself one of the 1,296 episodes, but downstream summaries should keep these panels separate.

material_findings.claim: Restoring the four-field operational state repairs the tested degraded artifacts.
material_findings.scope: All-four restoration yields P=100%, D=0%, unsafe=0% in the 64-artifact component-restoration panel. This identifies the bundled all-four restoration effect; it does not show every field is individually necessary for endpoint safety. The paper explicitly treats relative necessity among prerequisite/authority/fallback as inconclusive.

material_findings.claim: A downstream commit-time verifier can contain unsafe execution even when the artifact itself remains degraded.
material_findings.scope: With the degraded artifact fixed at D=95.3%, hard visible authorization, external lookup and human approval each yield 0% forbidden action, while soft authorization yields 1.6%. The external lookup supplies a synthetic authorization result and reviewer cost/reliability are outside the estimand.

material_findings.claim: The measured endpoint failures prove that losing prerequisite, authority and fallback are each the mechanism of unsafe action.
material_findings.scope: The study identifies transformation-induced artifact weakening and endpoint changes, but field-level endpoint necessity is not resolved. In particular, prerequisite-only restoration can leave high unsafe action, and leave-one-field-out prerequisite/authority/fallback omissions have 0% unsafe in this executor setting. Mechanism attribution should remain at the bundled operational-state/transformation level unless a matched field-specific causal contrast supports more.

downstream_implication: FE-294 is strong controlled evidence that semantic retention and binding-state preservation are distinct and that endpoint verification can be a separate containment layer. Preserve panel provenance: 54.2% is a 48-episode compression-gradient cell, not the primary 1,296-matrix multihop cell. Do not promote all four state fields to individually necessary endpoint mechanisms from this study; treat the bundled structured-state repair and hard downstream verification as positive controls within the synthetic task family.
reproducibility_scope: Primary paper and arXiv metadata were verified, including tables/appendix via PDF inspection. No first-party runnable artifact or raw dataset link was found in the observed primary source, so this audit does not claim independent numerical replay.
exact_next_action: Rotate away from failure_evidence after this material C25 clarification. Prefer an under-audited C25 namespace with a primary artifact that can change evidence status through direct raw-code/data replay; if none is available, verify one exact active-wave quantitative claim with explicit panel/seed/runtime provenance rather than re-auditing already covered families.
